definitions.principal: Trusted issuer and subject mapped to an explicit human or service identity; no email-based identity merging.
definitions.service: Autonomous registered OAuth client, never a delegated human actor in this slice.
definitions.interaction: One cryptographically verified request projected into predecessor session storage for authorization only.
definitions.grant: Server-owned current permission in local policy; token roles are not grants.
definitions.revocation: Local policy removal/disable takes effect on next policy snapshot; issuer token status checked online each request.

human.refresh: not used; reauthenticate at access-token expiry

service.sender_constraint: not in first local slice; bearer replay remains possible until expiry/revocation

prototype_constraints.loopback_http_exception: Local test accounts only; cookies are HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax without Secure on loopback HTTP; production requires HTTPS and Secure cookies.
prototype_constraints.policy: one local file snapshot per request; immutable private SQLite projection; later policy mutations affect the next request
prototype_constraints.identity_projection: kind-prefixed principal id stored in legacy user_id; kind retained and checked in successor bridge, no human-assurance assertion for services

business_acceptance: human can sign in and read permitted document
service can prove private-key control and read permitted document
caller cannot select trusted evidence or grants
open_questions: Distributed policy, refresh rotation and revocation latency under partitions
Sender constraint, workload attestation, delegation and multi-tenancy
Full DomainSpec compiler and formal correspondence coverage for successor
